description: Places a child block of a canvas at a data point of a chart instead of PositionX / PositionY (0.9.9). When X, Y or the area size is missing, PositionX and PositionY are used

X.description: Data value on the X axis

Y.description: Data value on the Y axis

AreaWidth.description: Width of the chart shapes in pixels

AreaHeight.description: Height of the chart shapes in pixels

AnchorX.description: Which point of the block sits on the data point horizontally. Defaults to Center

AnchorY.description: Which point of the block sits on the data point vertically. Defaults to Center

OffsetX.description: Shifts the block horizontally, in pixels

OffsetY.description: Shifts the block vertically, in pixels
